Bishoujo Hanafuda Kikou - Michinoku Hito.name: Bishoujo Hanafuda Kikou Michinoku Hitou Koi Monogatari Special
Bishoujo Hanafuda Kikou - Michinoku Hito.summary: Bishoujo Hanafuda Kikou Michinoku Hitou Koi Monogatari Special is a table game developed by O-Two and published by FOG for the Sega Saturn. It is based on the Japanese card game Hanafuda, and was released four months after the PlayStation version.
